It unfolds `disjointed`, shows `Iio (succ i) = Iic i` using `lt_succ_iff_eq_or_lt_of_not_isMax`, turns the sup over `Iic i` into `partialSups f i`, and rewrites with `hf.partialSups_eq`. `disjointed_succ` proves the same identification with `lt_succ_iff_of_not_isMax`, and `Monotone.disjointed_succ` (declared earlier, under the same `[SuccOrder ι]` and `LinearOrder ι` hypotheses) packages the monotone case as `disjointed f (succ i) = f (succ i) \ f i`. The same `h : ¬IsMax i` is in scope, so the branch becomes `rw [hf.disjointed_succ h, sdiff_sup_cancel (hf (le_succ i))]`. The final `sdiff_sup_cancel` step is the one the current proof already uses. The benefit is modest: the order-theoretic identification and `partialSups` conversion then live in one place. The duplicated part is only a few lines, so this is a borderline but real case. It has not been compiled.

claims.reason: The fact `(Iio i).biUnion Iic = Iio i` is proved twice with the same witness pair `⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ha.2.trans_lt ha.1, fun hr ↦ ⟨r, hr, le_rfl⟩⟩`. The first proof is `hun` in `partialSups_disjointed` (lines 139-140). The second is inline at the end of `disjointed_partialSups` (lines 177-178), after `congr 2 with r`. Both are in the `PartialOrder ι` + `LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι` section and use the same `sup_biUnion` strategy to turn `(Iio i).sup` into a sup of `partialSups`. The `univ` variant in `Fintype.sup_disjointed` is a different, simpler fact and should not be folded in. A single private lemma needs only `DecidableEq ι`, which both proofs already get from `classical`. The saving is small, since the argument is a two-line lower-set fact. But it is a genuine verbatim duplication, so naming it once is worthwhile. The `disjointed_partialSups` rewrite may need the goal shape adjusted after `congr 2 with r`; this is untested.
claims.shared_lemma: private lemma biUnion_Iic_Iio [PartialOrder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι] [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) : (Iio i).biUnion Iic = Iio i := by ext r; simpa using ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ha.2.trans_lt ha.1, fun hr ↦ ⟨r, hr, le_rfl⟩⟩
rewritten_uses: In `partialSups_disjointed`: delete `have hun …` and use `rw [← biUnion_Iic_Iio i, sup_biUnion, …]` and `biUnion_Iic_Iio i` in place of `hun` in the later `simp only`.

In `disjointed_partialSups`: replace `congr 2 with r; simpa only [mem_biUnion, mem_Iio, mem_Iic] using ⟨…⟩` with `rw [biUnion_Iic_Iio]`, or with `Finset.ext_iff.mp (biUnion_Iic_Iio i) r` if the goal is still membership-wise.
